widgets_values: A woman was singing wildly. She was in a heavy mood, showing intensity, sadness and vulnerability. Her eyebrows were furrowed, her lips pursed, and her eyes seemed to bulge from time to time. She emphasizes the pronunciation of words with her mouth. She tilted her head slightly, nodded, and occasionally moved it slightly to the rhythm of the song. These are all subtle movements. Her face and upper chest. The movements of her shoulders and chest seem to indicate her breathing control and physical strength for singing. She held the microphone tightly, and her fingers seemed a little nervous while singing. Her hand moved slightly along with the microphone. The camera is almost entirely in a tight close-up. This makes the audience's attention completely focused on the woman's face, magnifying her emotional expression, very slowly and gently zooming or panning. The purpose of doing this is to avoid distracting movements and focus attention on her face.
